sentences.text: The home loan KFS shows the processing fee as ₹400 as a one-time fee.
The home loan agreement also lists the processing fee as ₹400 once, at sanction.
I do not see any in-force document here showing a processing fee of ₹4,000 for this home loan.
The superseded 2024 KFS rules are no longer in force as of 2026-11-23, so they do not change the current fee shown in the bank documents.

missing.searched: Searched the in-force home loan KFS and home loan agreement fee disclosures; neither shows a ₹4,000 processing fee.
